latest.title: Higher smooth surgery structure sets of complex projective spaces, part II
latest.abstract: We determine the torsion part of the higher smooth surgery structure sets of complex projective spaces (up to some extension problems) and complete the description of the forgetful map to their topological versions in low dimensions. In addition, an application to mapping class groups of complex projective spaces in low dimensions is presented.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 确定复射影空间高阶光滑 surgery structure set 的挠部分，并描述低维到拓扑版本的遗忘映射。
latest.breakthrough: 补全该系列的高阶结构计算，并给出低维复射影空间映射类群应用。
latest.limitations: 挠部分仍保留若干扩张问题，且低维应用范围有限。
latest.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 60/100。
